dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Odette is on the at-risk list due to medical concerns. Odette is a elderly dog who was brought in as a stray. We have assessed Odette to have a severe respiratory infection with possible pneumonia and will need ongoing care that we can not provide. She has allowed most handling, but can get worked up quickly leading to more breathing difficulties.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I can go home today!

I have medical needs that staff will address with you when you meet me.

I would appreciate slow introductions to new people and places to help me feel safe.
dog.name: Odette
